data.exact_reserve_text: In addition to a low incidence of catastrophe losses, the year benefited from a significant favourable prior year reserve development within the Marine, Energy and long-tail inward reinsurance portfolios, together with better than expected attritional development on International Property binders.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reports that 2015 benefited from significant favourable prior year reserve development in Marine, Energy and long-tail inward reinsurance portfolios and better than expected attritional development on International Property binders. However, the only available claims development triangle is presented net of reinsurance and, when analysed for underwriting years 2013 and earlier, indicates a net adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 175.3m (net of reinsurance). No gross prior-year re-estimation figure is explicitly disclosed, so the gross prior-year movement could not be determined from the report.
raw_causal_phrases: a significant favourable prior year reserve development within the Marine, Energy and long-tail inward reinsurance portfolios
better than expected attritional development on International Property binders

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement is disclosed in the report. The prior year movement value above (GBP 175.253m) is derived from the net claims development triangle (note 15) and therefore is NET of reinsurance (last-resort fallback). This is inconsistent with the Managing Agent narrative which describes "significant favourable prior year reserve development" in specific portfolios; the gross PYD could not be determined from the available disclosures. All triangle amounts are presented in thousands in the report.
